# EveVps

> EveVps sells unmanaged Windows RDP servers and KVM Linux VPS servers hosted in New York, USA. Plans start at $11.99 per month, payment is by cryptocurrency, and servers are set up automatically, usually within 1 minute of the payment confirming.

Key facts:

- Products: Windows RDP (Windows 10 or 11, full Administrator access) and Linux VPS (KVM, full root access).
- Location: New York, USA.
- Hardware: Intel Xeon Gold 6152 processors, NVMe SSD storage, 1 Gbps port, dedicated IPv4 address.
- Included with every plan: always-on DDoS protection and unlimited operating system reinstalls from the control panel.
- Linux distributions: Ubuntu, Debian, AlmaLinux, Rocky Linux, CentOS Stream, Fedora and Alpine.
- Payment: cryptocurrency only, including Bitcoin (BTC), Tether (USDT), Ethereum (ETH) and Litecoin (LTC).
- Setup time: automatic, usually within 1 minute of a confirmed payment.
- Management: unmanaged. The customer manages the software; EveVps looks after hardware, network and DDoS protection.
- Support: support@evevps.com or a ticket in the client area. Replies within 30 minutes.
- Refunds: full refund if a server is not delivered within 24 hours of a confirmed payment. Delivered servers are not refundable.

## Plans and prices

Windows RDP and Linux VPS use the same five plans. Prices are per month in US dollars.

| Plan | vCPU | RAM | NVMe storage | Price per month |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Silver | 2 | 4 GB | 50 GB | $11.99 |
| Gold | 4 | 8 GB | 100 GB | $22.39 |
| Champion | 6 | 16 GB | 130 GB | $35.99 |
| Titan | 6 | 32 GB | 150 GB | $49.99 |
| Legend | 8 | 64 GB | 200 GB | $75.99 |

## Products

- [Windows RDP](https://www.evevps.com/windows-rdp): Windows 10 or 11 remote desktop server in New York with full Administrator access.
- [Linux VPS](https://www.evevps.com/linux-vps): KVM Linux VPS in New York with full root access.
- [Buy RDP with crypto](https://www.evevps.com/buy-rdp-crypto): how to buy a Windows RDP with Bitcoin, USDT, Ethereum, Litecoin and other cryptocurrencies.

## Use cases

- [Forex VPS](https://www.evevps.com/forex-vps): running MT4, MT5 and expert advisors 24/7 on a Windows server in New York.
- [Docker VPS](https://www.evevps.com/docker-vps): running Docker and Docker Compose on a KVM VPS with root access.
- [n8n VPS](https://www.evevps.com/n8n-vps): self-hosting n8n automation workflows.
